verdict.rationale: Ramp exposes a public API, official CLI, and MCP server (ramp-probe-1/2/3) plus CSV export/import (ramp-docs-12) that would let an AI-native user script bulk actions, and AI agents already auto-code/categorize transactions at scale across the platform (ramp-docs-15, ramp-docs-17). However there's no direct evidence of a dedicated bulk-edit/bulk-approve UI or documented batch endpoints for acting on many items simultaneously. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation API endpoints or UI (bulk approve, bulk export, batch transaction updates) and independent confirmation these programmatic paths work for large-scale bulk actions.
